content_of_post_to_answer: How can changing your way of thinking change your life and help you overcome obstacles?
answer: Changing your thinking doesn't necessarily remove an obstacle; it changes what you believe is possible in response to it. A setback interpreted as evidence of personal failure often leads to avoidance, while the same setback viewed as information encourages adjustment. That distinction gradually changes behavior, and behavior changes outcomes. I've explored this relationship further in some of my other writing on my Quora profile. Perhaps the deepest shift is realizing that your circumstances may limit your options, but your interpretation determines which options you notice.
